source: USDA FoodData Central, Foundation Foods, April 2026 release (FoodData_Central_foundation_food_json_2026-04-30). https://fdc.nal.usda.gov/download-datasets
how: Each food here was matched (same food, same form) to a Foundation Foods entry, recorded in its `ff` field. Every nutrient Foundation measured replaced the SR Legacy value; the rest stayed SR Legacy. Not taken: folate (Foundation reports none in DFE), fiber for animal foods, iodine where the Iodine Database already supplied it, a Foundation 0 where SR had a value (Foundation often records 0 when a nutrient was not quantified), and Brazil nut selenium (it varies enormously by soil; the higher SR value keeps the upper limit safe). Matches whose energy or protein differed by more than ~25-30% were not applied.
